correctness.rationale: Inspected the actual 12906-byte RESULT and checker source. Pair orbitals of k-subsets are intersection sizes; graph automorphisms preserve graph distance, so the 2-closure is the known full group G. A triple with common (k-1)-intersection and complements with (k-2)-intersection excludes complement from 3-closure, even for k=2. H-orbits on r-tuples equal integer Venn profiles a_eps, and complement reverses eps; fixed profiles have 2^(r-1) equal opposite-cell counts summing k, giving B_r=binom(k+2^(r-1)-1,2^(r-1)-1). Burnside yields (A_r+B_r)/2; Stirling inversion handles distinct tuples. For three distinct sets, the eight Venn cells yield the exact interval L≤t≤U and involution t↦p+q+u-k-t, giving ceiling(N/2) orbits; independent pair-stabilizer count supports closed I3/J3 formulas. The rational Venn polytope has 2^r-r-1 independent degrees of freedom and an interior point, yielding the stated fixed-r asymptotic. Independent integer reconstruction matched all ternary counts for k=2..11; small finite checks do not prove unbounded formulas. Source verifies k2 special 48 automorphisms; the proof treats repeated coordinates explicitly.
